comparisons.name: overflow-light
comparisons.description: Three 80 pt items in a 300 pt bar, which holds them, and in a 220 pt bar, which holds two, Aqua: the third item is cut off whole, and the bar that fits draws no overflow button. The capture is taken with animations off, which also switches off the scroll-driven animation that shows the button, so the fixture makes the second bar's button visible itself and the check reads the chevrons' drawing only; that the button appears by itself is tested in favorites-bar.browser.test.tsx.
